column1: # Stage S8 V1 — the graphics engine's GPU code becomes two graphics crates: its device folder (the pooled lane
# buffers and the readback guard) becomes gpu_device, its module root that crate's root, and its frame, draw,
# pipeline and loop folders become gpu_frame, the loop folder as frame_pump (`loop` is a keyword, and a module
# name says what it holds); the graphics engine documentation moves to the mirror of the graphics crates, the
# overview under a name that says what it covers. Paths name the tree before the moves; the graphics engine
# keeps re-export shims at its module paths until the stage switch.
